description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceReviewSaveController class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically in the Performance plugin's Controller namespace. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the rendering of a component for saving performance reviews, distinguishing between editing an existing review and adding a new one based on request attributes.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSaveController
classes.description: Controller class managing the display of the performance review save view, handling both 'edit' and 'add' review scenarios.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component based on whether an existing review ID is present in the request; sets the component for rendering accordingly.
